resources.string: Choose a 5G mode for each SIM

These options select the type of 5G connection, not the preferred network type. LTE and other permitted networks remain available. SA requires carrier and SIM support; these settings do not enable VoNR.
No active SIM. Insert or enable a SIM to configure its 5G mode.
Only the device owner can configure SIM radio modes.
Use SA only for this SIM?
NSA will not be used. Without compatible SA coverage you may fall back to LTE or another allowed network. This does not guarantee SA registration or VoNR.
The selected preference and the HAL/RIL configuration readback are shown separately. The readback may come from a RIL cache; a matching value does not prove modem application or 5G SA registration.
Turn off airplane mode to change the 5G preference.
Waiting for the radio backend. Not confirmed.
Sending the preference. Not yet confirmed.
Preference matches the HAL/RIL configuration readback.
